name: small-business-owner
description: Small business owners can manage money, customers, and marketing from one plugin. The finance skills all read from QuickBooks, so a payroll check, an overdue invoice, and a business health briefing work from the same books. The sales skills follow a deal from prospect research through the proposal and the follow-up. The marketing skills plan content and write campaigns for email and social media. The finance skills require the QuickBooks connector, and the overdue invoice follow-up also needs Gmail or Outlook.

connectors.label: QuickBooks
connectors.description: The finance skills read invoices, bills, payroll, and deposits from your QuickBooks books.
